items.title: Norway mourns King Harald as Haakon VIII ascends throne
items.description: Mourners gather outside the palace as royals, politicians and citizens remember a beloved king, whose son has adopted the family motto "all for norway".

items.title: Oslo mayor calls off wedding ceremony after death of Norway's king
items.description: Anne Lindboe, the mayor of Norway's capital, had planned to marry her fiance on Friday.

items.title: Russia ramps up rhetoric but wants to avoid war with Nato, Western officials say
items.description: But they say Moscow will likely continue its "hybrid activity" against Nato members, short of direct military action.

items.title: Right-wing commentator Milo Yiannopoulos detained by ICE
items.description: The British citizen, who lives and works in the US, has supported Trump and ICE agents in the past.

items.title: Thieves steal 600-diamond necklace from Vienna museum in broad daylight
items.description: Police are hunting two suspects they believe bought a ticket for the exhibition to get at the jewellery.

items.title: Greenland says findings on genocide allegation not final
items.description: Experts examined the use of forced contraception on the Inuit community during the 1960s and 70s.

items.title: Violence breaks out in Ceuta as migrant crisis continues
items.description: A group of migrants is accused of throwing stones at a military vehicle, while some locals set fire to their camps on the beach.
